extras: Note: This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. iOS clipboard restrictions may cause silent failures.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that automatically copies highlighted text to the clipboard whenever the selection changes — the same behavior Linux users know as "primary selection" on X11, brought into Obsidian on every platform.
problem: Obsidian lacks the automatic clipboard copying feature found in Linux environments when text is selected.
summary: Automatically copies highlighted text to the clipboard whenever the selection changes, mimicking the primary selection behavior found in Linux environments.
